gameMetas.description: Classic Doom: Tech-base invasion to Hell across 3 episodes. Tight corridors, key hunts, and demon hordes in the original 1993 FPS.
Doom Shareware: Free episode 1 only (Knee-Deep in the Dead). Perfect intro to Doom's fast combat and maze exploration.
The Ultimate Doom: Original Doom + bonus episode 4 'Thy Flesh Consumed.' Shorter, deadlier maps for veterans.
Doom II: Hell on Earth. Super shotgun debuts alongside revenants and arch-viles in a 32-map Hell invasion.
Final Doom: TNT Evilution. TeamTNT's 32 structured maps from marine base to fiery Hell finale.
Final Doom: Plutonia Experiment. 32 brutal slaughter maps heavy on chaingunners and tight fights.

gameMetas.displayName: DOOM II: No Rest for the Living
gameMetas.description: No Rest for the Living: 9 dense Doom II maps from the XBLA era. Modern layouts with classic vanilla rules.
Tarkov Factory of Doom. Scavs roaming the industrial factory, while evil Tagilla lurks in the shadows. Are you Chad enough to make it to extract?
Army of Darkness Doom II. Groovy boomstick action and chainsaw mayhem in a Doom II total conversion.
